notes.title: New Steam Items Just Released: Get Yours Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, gamers!

We’re happy to share that new Steam community items are now available! Unlock exclusive trading cards, beautify your profile with fresh backgrounds, and express yourself with new emoticons and avatar frames.

Jump into the game and start collecting these awesome rewards today. Thank you for being a part of our amazing community!

Best regards,
Octo Games Team[/h3]
